research_question: Do pre-specified economic-function groups explain cross-asset valuation better than a raw count of functions?
active_universe_rule: Use every complete_human_verified cryptoasset not listed in config/research_scope.json excluded_assets. Do not add or remove assets from observed outcomes.

predeclared_nested_models.reason: Tests whether direct holder capture adds information beyond the number of functions.
Tests whether service demand and token-linked capture are jointly informative.

decision_rule: The theory-group approach is favored only if it improves leave-one-asset-out prediction relative to raw breadth and its relevant coefficients remain directionally stable across predeclared sensitivities. Statistical significance alone is insufficient.
guardrails: Assets may belong to multiple groups.
Do not change bundle definitions, assets, outcomes, or sensitivities after estimation.
Report every listed group model, including null and sign-reversed results.
This is a post-pilot exploratory extension, not an independent confirmatory test.
No causal interpretation is permitted from the cross-sectional design.
